scientific_integrity: Analytic exact formula and all equality cases proved using weighted Young inequalities. Finite numerical checks supplement rather than establish the proof. The p=2 Hilbert case is previously known.
scientific_limitations: Nonnegative diagonal potential at coordinate zero, 1<p<infinity; no full numerical-range classification, endpoint p, complex potentials or arbitrary defects. An equivalent older non-Hilbert formula remains possible.
title: Orientation-dependent boundary thresholds for the spatial numerical radius on \(\ell_p\)
